dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly contoured high-intensity 'O' and 'C' perimeters displaying sharp contrast transitions from dark exterior pixels to lighter ring pixels, with most interiors reverting to the darker base intensity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, amorphous high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, distributed primarily across the upper-central and posterior regions of the visible patterned surface.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent circular annuli in the mid-right visual field form an obtuse triangle, while a fourth larger annulus to the lower-left extends this into an irregular quadrilateral.
